waybackify cache status [flags] <dir>

Summarize a cache root against a ledger

One glance at how far a cache root is toward the ledger under <dir>:
the capture-state histogram (cached | unfetched | interstitial |
error), the same per top-level directory of the ledger, the
unfetched split into gone (the archive lacks it) and pending, the
captures no further pass will fix with their remedy, and the
store's footprint. Read-only, no network.

Output: a report on stdout (--json for the raw record). Exit 0
when nothing is pending and nothing needs attention, 1 otherwise.

Arguments:
  <dir>              root to discover manifests and capture lists under

Flags:
  --root|-r <root>   cache root to summarize — required
  --json             emit the raw record as JSON
  --help|-h          Show help

part of the wayback mirror tooling
